data.title: ADNEC Group Kickstarts November with Two of the World’s Largest Events in the Energy and Tourism Sectors
data.description:
ADNEC Group Kickstarts November with Two of the World’s Largest Events in the Energy and Tourism Sectors

ADNEC Group, a Modon company, begins November by hosting two of the world’s most significant international events in the same week. ADIPEC 2026, the world’s largest energy event, takes place at ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi from 2 to 5 November. Meanwhile, World Travel Market (WTM) London, one of the global travel industry’s leading gatherings, takes place at the Group’s Excel London venue from 3 to 5 November.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261030918463/en/

ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi (Photo: AETOSWire)

The two events, held simultaneously at the Group’s largest venues in the UAE and the UK, reflect ADNEC Group’s capability to deliver large-scale international events across multiple markets.

ADIPEC has grown alongside the venue since it was first held at the ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi in 2006. This year’s edition is set to be the largest in the event’s history, occupying the venue’s entire 153,000 square metres of exhibition space, along with additional halls built, featuring more than 2,000 exhibitors, multiple country pavilions, and dedicated zones for digitalisation, decarbonisation, and artificial intelligence.

In London, Excel London will welcome travel and tourism professionals from around the world for World Travel Market London, where destinations, travel brands and industry leaders meet to do business and shape the future of the sector.

Together, ADIPEC Abu Dhabi and WTM London demonstrate the strength of ADNEC Group’s international venue portfolio and its ability to host world-leading events that drive economic growth, industry collaboration and global connectivity.

By welcoming hundreds of thousands of participants across Abu Dhabi and London, the Group continues to reinforce its role as a trusted partner for major international exhibitions and conferences, while supporting the long-term development of the sectors and destinations it serves.

Source: AETOSWire

Fatin Elkhalil
felkhalil@apcoworldwide.com

data.title: Purina Films Docuseries, 'A Different Breed,' Sweeps Three Daytime Emmy® Awards
data.description:
Purina Films Docuseries, 'A Different Breed,' Sweeps Three Daytime Emmy® Awards

Purina Films Docuseries, 'A Different Breed,' Sweeps Three Daytime Emmy® Awards

PR Newswire

ST. LOUIS, Oct. 30, 2026

Emmy-winning series celebrates the extraordinary bond between people and pets and marks a major milestone for Purina Films

ST. LOUIS, Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Purina is celebrating a major milestone for Purina Films as A Different Breed, its original nine-episode documentary series produced in partnership with InkBlot Narratives, today was named the winner of three Daytime Emmy® Awards, including Outstanding Lifestyle Program, Outstanding Editing for a Daytime Non-Studio Program and Outstanding Directing for a Daytime Non-Studio Non-Fiction Series.

 A Different Breed, an original documentary series from Purina Films was named the winner of three Daytime Emmy® Awards.

The recognition celebrates the power of storytelling that puts people and pets at the center. Streaming exclusively on Prime Video, A Different Breed takes viewers behind the scenes of the Purina Pro Plan Incredible Dog Challenge, following 18 teams as they pursue excellence across canine performance sports while revealing the dedication, passion and extraordinary relationships that fuel them.

"Three Daytime Emmy® Awards is an extraordinary achievement and a proud moment for everyone who brought A Different Breed to life," said Andrea Faccio, President and Chief Growth Officer at Purina. "I've always believed the most powerful stories go beyond the moments we see on screen to reveal the dedication, the setbacks and the remarkable relationships behind them – and with A Different Breed, we set out to celebrate that incredible bond between people and pets. Seeing these stories resonate with audiences and earn recognition from the television industry makes these awards even more meaningful."

On October 24, 2026, A Different Breed: Showdown at the Farms, a standalone documentary special from the A Different Breed series available on YouTube won the 2026 Mid-America Emmy Award for Editor - Short Form or Long Form Content. The special brings viewers closer to the people and dogs behind canine performance sports, showcasing the teamwork, determination and connection that make the competition extraordinary.

The awards mark a significant milestone for Purina Films and reflect a new way for Purina to connect with pet lovers. Rather than placing the brand at the center, A Different Breed puts the spotlight on the competitors, their dogs and the stories behind the sport, allowing viewers to experience the human-pet bond firsthand. Through this approach of investing in premium entertainment that puts pet parents and their interests first, Purina is creating meaningful connections and demonstrating how brands can participate in culture through stories people actively choose to watch.

The recognition also comes as Purina looks ahead to the next chapter of A Different Breed. Season 2 is currently in post-production. The next season will bring audiences new competitors, new journeys and more of the incredible stories behind canine performance sports. More information on release timing and platform will be available soon.

The Purina Pro Plan Incredible Dog Challenge serves as the backdrop for the series. For nearly 30 years, the competition has showcased extraordinary canine athletes and their handlers across events including high-flying disc routines, agility courses, weave pole racing and diving dog competitions.

A Different Breed was produced by Purina Films in partnership with InkBlot Narratives and distributed exclusively on Prime Video in the U.S. Stream all nine episodes of the Emmy®-winning A Different Breed now on Prime Video.

About Nestlé Purina PetCare 
Nestlé Purina PetCare creates richer lives for pets and the people who love them. Founded in 1894, Purina has helped dogs and cats live longer, healthier lives by offering scientifically based nutritional innovations.

Purina manufactures some of the world's most trusted and popular pet care products, including Dog Chow, Purina ONE, Pro Plan, Friskies and Tidy Cats. Our more than 11,000 U.S. associates take pride in our trusted pet food, treat and litter brands that feed 46 million dogs and 68 million cats every year. Nearly 500 Purina scientists, veterinarians, and pet care experts ensure our commitment to unsurpassed quality and nutrition.

Over the past five years, Purina has contributed more than $150 million towards organizations that bring, and keep, people and pets together, as well as those that help our communities and environment thrive.

Purina is part of Nestlé, a global leader in Nutrition, Health and Wellness. For more information, visit purina.com or subscribe here to get the latest Purina news.

data.title: ScienceOra Demonstrates AI-Assisted Hydrogen-Production Catalyst Design Workflow at Tencent Global Digital Ecosystem Summit
data.description:
ScienceOra Demonstrates AI-Assisted Hydrogen-Production Catalyst Design Workflow at Tencent Global Digital Ecosystem Summit

ScienceOra Demonstrates AI-Assisted Hydrogen-Production Catalyst Design Workflow at Tencent Global Digital Ecosystem Summit

PR Newswire

SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 30, 2026

The workflow spans literature analysis, candidate design, experimental planning and industrial decision support, extending AI4S into materials research

SHENZHEN, China, Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wenge AI demonstrated an AI-assisted hydrogen-production catalyst design workflow supported by ScienceOra at the 2026 Tencent Global Digital Ecosystem Summit. The demonstration showed how AI for Science (AI4S) can connect literature analysis, catalyst candidate design, experimental planning and industrial decision support, helping materials researchers translate scientific evidence into actionable research plans.

ScienceOra is Wenge AI's intelligent research decision platform, built on the ScienceOne Scientific Foundation Model. For specialist research tasks such as materials development, the platform brings together scientific models, professional literature, research data and tools to support information access, research-plan development and scientific decision-making.

From literature analysis to catalyst candidate design

The demonstration focused on the design of a high-entropy alloy catalyst for the alkaline hydrogen evolution reaction. To address the need for high activity and durability, ScienceOra searched professional literature and drew on published research methods and elemental properties to support the development of candidate designs. It also cross-checked optimization proposals against relevant literature, providing researchers with references that could be reviewed and verified.

Rather than simply generating material formulations, the workflow connects documentary evidence, materials knowledge and specific design objectives to support more targeted analysis of candidate solutions. Researchers remain responsible for assessing scientific validity and determining subsequent research directions.

From experimental planning to industrial decision support

For experimental planning, ScienceOra can assist in developing research protocols around candidate designs, helping researchers organize experimental variables and producing testing standard operating procedures (SOPs) and related reference information for subsequent validation.

For industrial applications, the platform can also support comparative analysis across dimensions such as the feasibility of scaled hydrogen production, performance at industrially relevant current densities, durability, raw-material availability and compatibility with mass-production synthesis processes. It can then assist in establishing decision priorities, screening criteria and process-improvement recommendations.

Candidate designs, experimental plans, process recommendations and references can be consolidated into a structured research report, helping R&D teams assess scientific evidence alongside engineering constraints. AI provides analytical and decision support, while experimental testing and scientific validation remain essential parts of materials research.

Previously disclosed collaboration reports design efficiency and activity improvements

In a previously disclosed industry–research collaboration on hydrogen-production catalyst design, ScienceOra supported literature analysis and research-plan development. The collaboration reported a 38% improvement in catalyst activity and reduced the design stage from several months to 30 minutes. The case illustrates the potential of domain-specific AI to connect scientific literature, research design and engineering requirements.

ScienceOra was recently made available on Tencent WorkBuddy, with an initial offering of more than 30 research expert agents and skills covering literature analysis, research hypotheses, plan design, modeling and simulation, validation analysis and research communication. The conference demonstration further illustrated how ScienceOra can be applied to specialist materials research, as AI4S moves beyond general information processing toward support for research workflows and industrial R&D decision-making.

For more information, visit https://www.scienceone.ai/portal/.

About Wenge AI

Wenge AI (1956.HK) is a provider of artificial intelligence technology and service platform products for enterprises. With self-developed large models as its core, the company helps enterprises build practical intelligent platforms and applications. Founded by a team of AI scientists from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Wenge AI has deep technological expertise in large models, cognitive intelligence and complex-system modeling, and is committed to advancing AI from technological capabilities to enterprise-level applications.

data.title: Once Upon a Farm Announces Recall and Reformulation of Tractor Wheels™ Due to Potential Choking Hazard
data.description:
Once Upon a Farm Announces Recall and Reformulation of Tractor Wheels™ Due to Potential Choking Hazard

Once Upon a Farm is initiating a voluntary recall of its Tractor Wheels soft-baked bars due to potential choking hazard for toddlers ages 1.5 - 2.5. This decision was based on three consumer complaints. We acted out of an abundance of caution, in the best interest of our customers and our commitment to quality. We are working with the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) to make sure affected products are removed and families have the information they need.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261030258031/en/

No other Once Upon a Farm products are impacted by this recall.

Tractor Wheels were distributed nationwide via the internet and to distribution centers and retail stores in the following states and territories: AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, HI, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI and Puerto Rico.

Recalled products can be identified as follows:

  • Apple, Sweet Potato, & Spinach Tractor Wheels
  • Strawberry, Pumpkin, & Beet Tractor Wheels
  • Banana, Pumpkin & Cauliflower Tractor Wheels

Consumers who have purchased Once Upon a Farm Tractor Wheels should not open the package or use the contents. Instead, they should return the product to location of purchase for a full refund or contact care@uponafarm.com.

We know that parents place their trust in us every time they buy one of our products. We fell short of that, and that is why we are taking these aggressive actions.

About Once Upon a Farm

Once Upon a Farm, PBC (NYSE: OFRM) is redefining the organic kids’ food category and shaping the future of food. Guided by its mission to drive systemic improvement in childhood nutrition for a happier, healthier, more equitable world, the Company offers a portfolio of crave-worthy snacks and meals designed for children from babies through big kids. Once Upon a Farm products are organic, non-GMO, contain no added sugar‡* and are free from artificial flavors and colors – just simple, real, nutritious food kids ask for and parents trust. For more information, visit www.onceuponafarmorganics.com, follow @onceuponafarm on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.

‡Not a low calorie food.
*Except Refrigerated Protein Bars, which are sweetened with honey.

Alignment Healthcare Investigation Initiated: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Investigates the Officers and Directors of Alignment Healthcare, Inc. - ALHC

Alignment Healthcare Investigation Initiated: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Investigates the Officers and Directors of Alignment Healthcare, Inc. - ALHC

PR Newswire

NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 30, 2026

NEW ORLEANS, Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Former Attorney General of Louisiana, Charles C. Foti, Jr., Esq., a partner at the law firm of Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC ("KSF"), announces that KSF has commenced an investigation into Alignment Healthcare, Inc. ("Alignment" or the "Company") (NasdaqGS: ALHC).

On July 8, 2026, reports emerged that a former Alignment executive had filed a whistleblower lawsuit alleging that the Company deliberately misclassified $8 million to $10 million in routine operating expenses as capital expenditures to boost its stock price and executive compensation. According to the lawsuit, this maneuver artificially inflated the Company's adjusted EBITDA and allowed it to report its "first full year of positive adjusted EBITDA as a public company." Then, on September 15, 2026, at the Baird Global Healthcare Conference, Kao declined to comment on the Company's Star Ratings positioning, stating, "I cannot talk about it at all[.]" On October 8, 2026, Alignment disclosed that CMS had downgraded the Star Rating for its H3815 contract to 3.5, making the plan ineligible for quality bonus payments in fiscal 2028. Following these disclosures, the Company's share price declined precipitously.

KSF's investigation is focusing on whether Alignment's officers and/or directors breached their fiduciary duties to its shareholders or otherwise violated state or federal laws. 

If you have information that would assist KSF in its investigation, or have been a long-term holder of Alignment shares and would like to discuss your legal rights, you may, without obligation or cost to you, call toll-free at 1-833-538-3608 or email KSF Managing Partner Lewis Kahn (lewis.kahn@ksfcounsel.com), or visit https://www.ksfcounsel.com/cases/nasdaqgs-alhc/ to learn more.

data.title: Nômade Temple Holbox announces REVIVAL for New Year's Eve
data.description:
Nômade Temple Holbox announces REVIVAL for New Year's Eve

Nômade Temple Holbox announces REVIVAL for New Year's Eve

PR Newswire

ISLA HOLBOX, QUINTANA ROO, Mexico, Oct. 30, 2026

A celebration of renewal by the sea joins Bonding Season 2026–27, bringing wellness, music, gastronomy and ritual to the island from October through March.

ISLA HOLBOX, QUINTANA ROO, Mexico, Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nômade Temple Holbox announces REVIVAL, its New Year's Eve celebration on December 31, 2026, welcoming 2027 with dinner and music. The evening forms part of Bonding Season 2026–27, a wider invitation to spend time on the island through shared experiences.

REVIVAL invites guests to return to their natural rhythm, taking inspiration from the cycles of the moon, sun and ocean. At the turn of the year, the invitation is simple: make room to reconnect with yourself and the people around you.

An evening from sea to fire

Reception begins at 7:30 p.m., followed by dinner from 8:00 to 10:30 p.m. and celebrations until 3:00 a.m. Oysters and seasonal canapés introduce a menu featuring bluefin tuna, ember-cooked wild fish and Mexican Angus beef, followed by shared sides and desserts. A vegetarian menu is available.

Dinner-and-party admission includes a welcome drink and sparkling wine for the midnight toast. Party-only entry begins after 11:00 p.m. and includes a welcome drink. Capacity is limited. The musical lineup will be announced separately.

The setting is integral to the experience. Surrounded by the Yum Balam Nature Reserve, Nômade Temple Holbox brings the island's natural landscape into a stay shaped by water, local flavors and opportunities for discovery. REVIVAL offers a focal point for a longer escape, with seasonal programming to explore before and after the celebration.

Explore REVIVAL and reserve tickets

Bonding Season from October to March

Running from October 2026 through March 2027, Bonding Season extends the invitation beyond New Year's Eve. Guests can join individual experiences or follow a day shaped by movement, time in the water, creativity and gatherings around the table.

Morning Practice rotates through Vinyasa, Hatha, Ashtanga, Kundalini, Power and Yin Yoga, alongside Pilates, across the Gratitude Tent, beach and Sunset Deck. Playa Fit Club meets on Saturdays at 7:00 a.m. for running, calisthenics, cardio and functional movement.

Agua Mágica takes place on selected days at 11:30 a.m., using guided practice in the pool or sea to encourage a slower pace. Selected evenings bring breathwork, gong baths and lucid dreaming sound journeys to the Gratitude Tent, while cacao ceremonies and sunset rituals gather guests at the beach and Nest.

Creative Island offers journaling and painting at La Popular and the Sunset Deck. La Popular Sessions bring live music, DJ sets and island gatherings on Fridays and special dates, complemented by guest bartenders, beach gatherings and culinary moments throughout the season.

The season's announced highlights include:

October 30–November 2 — Día de Muertos. Four days of movement, ceremony, music and food, with the central celebration on October 31 featuring a skull workshop, guest make-up, La Playa Concert and a special ticketed dinner at La Popular.

November 20–23 — Subconscious Integration with Alecto Moure. This Immersive Journey includes Wisdom Tarot, a dinner gathering, family-tree exploration, Gestalt and Family Constellations. Workshops begin at 5:00 p.m. in the Gratitude Tent; the November 20 dinner takes place at 7:30 p.m. at La Popular, with reservations through the Journey Designer.

December and January — Festive programming, including New Year's Eve on December 31, continues through January 11. February and March programming is scheduled to be announced in January. Access and reservations vary by experience; guests should consult the calendar for current details.

About Nômade Temple Holbox

Set on the untouched shores of Isla Holbox, Nômade Temple Holbox is a luxury beachfront sanctuary designed for slow living and reconnection. The property features 30 rooms thoughtfully designed in three layers, from earth to sky, using sustainable local woods and advanced systems to maximize energy efficiency and responsible waste management. Conceived to exist in harmony with its natural surroundings, the hotel offers immersive wellness practices and personalized journeys guided by Journey Designers. Rooted in simplicity, sustainability, and presence, Nômade Temple Holbox delivers a barefoot luxury experience that invites guests to reconnect with themselves and the rhythms of the island.

Nômade Temple Holbox is part of Nomade People, a hospitality and lifestyle collective redefining travel through conscious design, cultural expression, and a deeply human approach to shared experiences.
